title: agentic-sdlc project adapter
description: The only file in a project that knows its stack. Every agent reads it; none hardcodes a package manager, a branch name or a test runner.

commits.description: Commit message style the lander and implementer follow.

engine.description: openspec: proposal/design/tasks + delta specs, validated by the openspec CLI. prd-frd: a PRD and an FRD with numbered requirements.

branchScheme.description: Placeholders are filled from the unit of work, e.g. {kind}/{slug}.

verifyCmd.description: The mechanical check: lint, types, tests. Without it nothing can be gated.

gateCmd.description: A heavier project-specific gate, run instead of verifyCmd when set.

secretScan.description: A command that fails when a credential appears in the branch's commits.

heavy.description: Prose rule for workloads that must be bounded or serialised.

profile.description: The kind of project this is: an opt-in standards profile from the plugin's profiles/ directory (webapp, library, service, compiler). One per project.

concerns.description: Cross-cutting standards from profiles/concerns/, applied in addition to the project-kind profile. A Go service needs service AND concurrency, so this is a list rather than a second single choice. Known: architecture, performance, memory, concurrency, data, platform.

reviewers.description: Agents the readiness gate fans out to.

protected.description: Branches a push may not reach without a passed gate receipt. Globs allowed.

maxAgeMin.description: How long a receipt stays valid.

enforce.description: What the PreToolUse hook refuses. Turning one off is a deliberate, recorded choice.

neverByAgent.description: Actions reserved to a human, stated for the agents to read.

quality.description: Deterministic analysis budget on NEW code. Peer-reviewed work on repositories that adopted coding agents reports persistent rises in analysis warnings and complexity, so the budget is on what a change adds, not on the whole repository.

cmd.description: Static analysis / coverage command; non-zero exit fails the gate.

coverageNewPct.description: Minimum coverage required on changed lines.

release.description: How a merged change reaches users. Merging is not shipping; this is the distance between them.

smokeCmd.description: Proves the change works in the environment it was deployed to, not in CI.

rollbackCmd.description: The written way back. A deployment without one is not ready.

environments.description: Lowest first. Production is never deployed before the environment below it has been observed.

approvals.description: Which actions need a named human. An agent can never satisfy a 'human' approval: it records who is accountable, and an agent approving its own work records nothing.

attributeCommits.description: Add an agent identity trailer to commits, so a change can be traced to the actor that made it.
